notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]We are super happy to announce that our game is now eligible for Steam Trading Cards![/b]

If you notice on our Store page, the ugly "Profile features limited" message is not there anymore.

[h2]Cards are Available! Feel free to enjoy them![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/96eba2a5dba2da9017e59a9b05ee0dc29110581d.jpg[/img]



We also carefully selected our cutest backgrounds for you to unlock!
[b]Do you want to personalize your Steam profile with an awesome artwork from Tiffy? Now you can![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/12155a07462e1725d90f53aeba725299495e54fa.jpg[/img]


Feel free to let us know what you think or if you have any suggestions.
For updates and news follow us on:

[url=https://twitter.com/NeoclassicGames]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames]Steam[/url]

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
We are happy to be back with our first big update.
We paid very close attention to your feedback and we really wanted to thank you for your support! We really care about Tiffy so we are doing our best to keep her game updated & provide the best possible experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/19317030bc51a08713ebcb7f37841d1bf43860dd.jpg[/img]


Anyway here are the patch notes for the update that landed a couple of days ago, It includes both fixes and new content.

[b]New content:[/b]
[i]- Added the 18+ version of the artwork "Luxury Tiffy"
- Added the 18+ version of the artwork "Pizza delivery Tiffy"[/i]

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[i]- Major fixes to the gallery: now all the levels are fully visible (even if they don't feature a 18+ version)
- Fixed the "new dress available" notification popping too many times
- Fixed the "log" feature in the visual novel section of the game
- Fixed the color palette bug in "color mode"
- Various improvements the the "Pencil mode" section of the game
- Improved eye tracking feature for Tiffy's animated character model
- Moved the "YOU"RE A BIG BUGA!!" line to the correct category
- Fixed the nudie version of the level 5 image, which was not perfectly aligned.
- Various improvements to stability and performance[/i]

Well I think that's all!
[b]Feel free to let us know if you have further suggestions and/or ideas. We are also discussing with Tiffy about the possibility of adding new levels every couple of months. It will depend of her schedule.[/b]

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NeoclassicGames]Twitter[/url] for more news and updates!
Until our next update!

notes.title: Tiffy's notty secret is finally Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
[b]We are finally proud to announce that Tiffy's game is finally complete!![/b]
We really did our best in order to choose the coolest available artworks and create [b]engaging puzzles[/b] for you to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/19317030bc51a08713ebcb7f37841d1bf43860dd.jpg[/img]

And let's not forget about [b]the 4 Visual Novel episodes[/b]! Tiffy is very excited to get to know you in a more [i]personal[/i] way <3

We plan to keep this game updated and add more art as we go, also Steam Trading Cards & Profiile Backgrounds as soon as the feature becomes available to us.
If you want to stay in touch and get updates/additional rewards feel free to:

[url=https://twitter.com/NeoclassicGames]Follow us on Twitter!
[/url]


Until our next update!
